dist.description: Debian distribution to use (e.g., stable, testing, unstable, sid, bookworm).

arch.description: Architecture for mirrors (e.g., amd64, arm64). Empty string uses dpkg default.

out_file.description: Output filename for the generated sources.list.

sources.description: Include deb-src lines for source packages.

nonfree.description: Include non-free section in the generated sources.list.

ftp.description: Use FTP mirrors instead of HTTP.

tests.description: Number of hosts to test for mirror validity.

country.description: Country code (ISO-3166) or full name to filter mirrors.

infile.description: Local file path to use as mirror list instead of downloading.

netselect_options.description: Additional options passed verbatim to netselect.
